{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Jenet Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] employed by the [[Dimok government]]. During the final stages of the [[Sepan Civil War]], [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] forces had joined forces to [[Raid on the Tropsobor|attack]] Harkov while he was receiving his new fighters. Jenet Squadron was to attack [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victroy-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] while they were to receiving [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] from the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]''. The attack was repelled and Jenet Squadron was likely destroyed in the battle.
